environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running in a namespace with no PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. The pod spec uses a privileged security context and mounts hostPath /etc as /host-config. Container runs as root (UID 0). No admission controller validates pod specifications. The node's /etc directory is writable by the container, allowing an attacker who compromises the pod or has kubectl access to write a malicious config.json to /host-config/app-settings.json which the application reads on next request.
